framework: Local VectorBT study inputs and frozen native 144h BTC outcomes; no new order or trade simulator.

coverage_contract.ordinary_btc: Every selected ordinary BTC clock must map to its frozen 144h VectorBT outcome and reconcile the cached BTC price return.
coverage_contract.case_btc: Every case-first admitted BTC clock must map to the existing native policy 4 half-target/half-six-day fill.
coverage_contract.baseline: Reproduce the frozen 159-event BTC below-EMA-after-reservation ledger and the frozen 50/50 account growth and marked DD before reporting the candidate.
coverage_contract.2026: Require local BTC 5m close and realized funding coverage through each held position exit; reuse original ALT funded 5m curve.
coverage_contract.random: Only preserve already matched controls on exact asset + decision keys; added clocks have no control coverage.

notes: Input market observations end at the registered 2026-10-27 UTC signal candle. 2026 results are retrospective, not a fresh blind period.
